description: Work the task board. list: all tasks. take: claim an open task. accept/decline: answer a task proposed to you. start: begin (only when its dependencies are done). update: post a progress note. done: finish, with a one-line note on what changed for others. release: give it back. assign: give a task to a teammate.

branch.description: Git branch (start/done). Defaults to your current branch.

name: task
